scope: Read-only descriptive comparison of saved AR and native ViSpec returned token arrays. No forward, scoring, tuning or source changes.
index_convention: 0-based; first10 means indices0..9, includes index0. If one visible sequence is a complete prefix of the other, its end boundary is recorded separately from an actual content-token substitution. Identical sequences have no first divergence index.
stop_field_definition: The previously reported387 counts pairs where AR.eos_index != native.eos_index OR AR.cap_reached != native.cap_reached. These are observed stop outcomes/token lengths, not evidence of different configured stopping rules.

shared_stop_configuration.native_round_stop: native after-block EOS or new_token > max_new_tokens; returned/effective output first EOS or512 cap
